name: Vulture's Vigor
label: Quest
description: Vulture's Vigor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Death does indeed have wings in these blasted lands, traveler. I have witnessed the black slayers and bonepickers feasting upon the corpse of many a fallen explorer - sometimes feeding upon the most vile and disease ridden of carcasses. It is a wonder, then, how their internal systems overcome the pestilence that claims these lands.
Assist me in my studies, friend! Gizzards I need! Two snickerfang jowls will also be required for the base of the concoction.
You shall be rewarded two-fold for your efforts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not waste my time, friend. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most excellent! I shall get to work immediately. Perhaps a cure for many of the ailments of the world is to be found!
Ah yes, your reward - of course, should you require more of the gum, return to me and another task you shall be given.
